description: Read part n of a run's result (host.runs.get/wait inline only part 0). A run whose whole result fit inline reads back parts: 1, n: 0 with the full result. n past the last part fails with not_found.

run_id.description: The run id to read a part of.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.runs.part
